purpose: Record the post-browser-validation correction for the WarehousePickingWave San artifact without overwriting the pre-fix v6 snapshot.
root_cause: The picked task class interpolation was missing a closing brace, so the picked CSS class was not evaluated by San.
Vue v-for :key had been emitted as a separate San key binding instead of an inline s-for trackby clause, which can prevent loop-node state/class refresh.
changes: Closed the task picked class interpolation.
Migrated picker, order, wave, task, and exception loops to inline trackby.
Changed picker select/option to one-way value interpolation with the existing change handler.
Added generation/repair prompt constraints and validator checks for trackby and balanced interpolation delimiters.
